item.title: Waste Not Want Not
item.description: Behind an unmarked door at a busy shopping mall in Durban, 19-year-old Aphiwe is knee-deep in cardboard boxes. When her flat-packed stack reaches five feet high — almost as tall as she is — it’s ready to be sold. For Aphiwe, every box is more than trash. It’s money for food, transport, and medicine for her family.
